# Exam Compass — AI-Powered Exam Preparation Platform

## Overview
Exam Compass is an AI-powered exam preparation platform for Indian competitive exams and school boards.
It offers AI-generated mock tests, PYQs (Previous Year Questions), adaptive practice, deep analytics,
syllabus tracking, and a personalized AI study mentor called "Exa".

## Supported Exams
- JEE Main & Advanced (Engineering)
- NEET (Medical)
- CBSE/ICSE Foundation & Board Exams: Classes 8, 9, 10, 11, 12

## Core Public Routes
- / — Homepage / Landing Page
- /login — User Login (Google Auth)
- /founder — Ayush Kumar (Founder Page & Backstory)
- /jee-mains — JEE Main Exam Hub
- /jee-advanced — JEE Advanced Exam Hub
- /neet — NEET Exam Hub

- /class-12 — Class 12 Board Exam Hub
- /class-11 — Class 11 Exam Hub
- /class-10 — Class 10 Board Exam Hub
- /class-9 — Class 9 Exam Hub
- /class-8 — Class 8 Exam Hub


## Route Structure (per exam)
- /{exam} — Exam landing page with subject list
- /{exam}/{subject} — Subject page with topic list
- /{exam}/{subject}/{topic} — Topic page with key concepts and PYQs
- /{exam}/q/{slug} — Individual question page with solution

## Key Features
1. AI Mock Test Generator (JEE/NEET/UPSC-aligned)
2. Adaptive difficulty engine
3. Real-time performance analytics
4. Syllabus tracker with weightage
5. AI Chatbot mentor "Exa"
6. Leaderboards and gamification (XP, ranks)
7. Video lectures (YouTube integration)
8. Score predictor
9. Decision simulator

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Hosting)
- AI: Groq (Llama 3.3), Google Gemini
- PWA: Vite PWA Plugin

## Founder & Backstory
- **Founder & Lead Developer**: Ayush Kumar
- **Role**: Lead Student Developer and Creator of ExamCompass.
- **Current Status**: Class 12 student at Kendriya Vidyalaya (KV) Darbhanga, Bihar.
- **Backstory**: Ayush is a self-taught full-stack developer who built ExamCompass independently. While preparing for the JEE examination, he struggled to balance KV Darbhanga school hours with hours of online lectures (Physics Wallah, Byju's, and YouTube tutorials). Realizing that traditional EdTech lacked elite diagnostic metrics, precise analytical features, and personalized roadmaps, he set out to build it himself.
- **IIT Delhi Hackathon**: The initial concept was built for IHFC's "AI Vidya Setu Hackathon" at IIT Delhi, where Ayush and his team secured Zonal 5th and became National Finalists. Though they fell short in the Nationals due to presentation skills, the experience fueled Ayush's resolve to build the full web platform completely on his own.
